tools.name: browse_models_by_category
tools.description: Browse AI models by category on ModelsLab. Navigate to a specific model category page to see available models.

category.description: Model category. Options: "stable-diffusion" (SD 1.5 models), "sdxl" (SDXL models), "flux" (FLUX models), "lora" (LoRA fine-tunes), "controlnet", "voice-cloning", "embeddings", "vae"

tools.name: get_api_documentation
tools.description: Get the API documentation and code examples for the current model. Switches to the API Documentation tab and extracts the code snippets.

tools.name: get_current_model_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about the AI model currently being viewed, including its name, model ID, provider, and available API endpoints.

tools.name: get_current_page_info
tools.description: Get information about the current page the user is viewing on ModelsLab, including the page title, URL, and any model/product details visible.

tools.name: get_model_id
tools.description: Get the model ID (slug) for the current AI model. Useful for API integration — this is the ID you pass to the ModelsLab API.

tools.name: get_platform_info
tools.description: Get information about ModelsLab platform capabilities, pricing tiers, and available AI services. Returns a structured overview of what ModelsLab offers.

tools.name: list_related_apis
tools.description: List all related API endpoints shown on the current model page. Returns names, descriptions, and providers of similar AI models/APIs.

limit.description: Maximum number of APIs to return (default: 20)

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate to a specific page on ModelsLab. Useful for going to playground, pricing, documentation, dashboard, or model pages.

page.description: Page to navigate to. Options: "playground", "playground/imagen" (image generation), "playground/video-fusion" (video), "playground/audio-gen" (audio/music), "playground/custom-llm" (chat/LLM), "playground/3d-verse" (3D), "pricing", "models" (browse all models), "dashboard", "search"

tools.name: open_related_model
tools.description: Navigate to a related AI model from the ones listed on this page. Provide the model slug or name.

model.description: Model slug (e.g. "ltx-2.3-i2v") or partial name to search for

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the ModelsLab AI model catalog. Returns matching models with their names, categories, and playground links. ModelsLab has 10,000+ models for image generation, video creation, voice synthesis, LLMs, and more.

query.description: Search keywords (e.g. "stable diffusion", "face swap", "text to speech")

tools.name: switch_model_tab
tools.description: Switch between tabs on the model detail page. Available tabs: "API Playground" (try the model), "API Documentation" (see code examples), "Ask ChatGPT" (get AI help), "Developer Support" (get help), "Model Specs" (technical details).

tab.description: Tab name to switch to. Options: "API Playground", "API Documentation", "Ask ChatGPT", "Developer Support", "Model Specs"
